name: Riebsamen RP electric tracked platform (RP 750 to RP 1500)
summary: A battery-electric, radio-controlled crawler carrier (750 to 1,500 kg payload) for pallets, beams, windows and glass panels on construction sites, with swap-on crane modules.

notes: Radio-controlled by an operator, not autonomous.
Crane modules KM 0.5 and KM 1.1 and a glass rack module are swap-on attachments (3 to 5 minutes).
The maker also lists indoor use (emission-free, quiet).
